title: 30 MINUTES HOT POWERFUL PRAYER TO COMMAND THE NEW DAY
text: I feel something. I feel something right now. Before I even open my mouth to teach, the atmosphere is already charged. The presence of the Holy Ghost is thick in this place. And I want you wherever you are, whether you are kneeling by your bedside, whether you are in your car, whether you are about to step into a day that you do not know the content of, I want you to just lift your hands for 30 seconds and worship. Not because I told you to, because he deserves it. Because the God who kept you through the night, the God who held your breath in his hands while you were unconscious in sleep, that God is worthy. We bless you, Lord. We magnify you. You are not a concept. You are not a theology. You are a living, breathing, active, present God. And we worship you. We worship you this morning. Baruch Hashem Adonai. Blessed be the name of the Lord. Shabari kola masikola rabba. Shondeliya kerimo bashandriko. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Yes, Lord. Yes, Lord. We hear you. We receive. Now, before we go into the depths of what the spirit of God wants to do this morning, I need you to do something. I need you to send this to someone right now. Not later. Not after. Now. There is someone connected to you, and I do not say this lightly. There is someone in your phone, on your contact list, on your timeline, who is about to face a day that has been designed by the enemy to take them out. And this prayer, this moment, is the lifeline heaven has prepared for them, but it will not reach them unless you send it. You are not just a listener. You are a distributor. You are an agent of heaven. God is using your tongue, your share button, your voice message to reroute somebody's destiny. So, send it now. >> [music] >> Be obedient and watch what happens. Good. Good. Now, sit with me. Open your spirit because what the spirit of God is about to teach is not theory, it is not theology for the classroom. It is a weapon. What you are about to hear is a weapon that if you wield it correctly will change the trajectory of your day, your week, your month, and the rest of your year. Are you ready? Are you truly ready? Open your Bibles to the book of Lamentations chapter 3 verses 22 through 23. The prophet Jeremiah writing from the deepest place of pain from the ashes of Jerusalem, from the rubble of a nation that had been destroyed, said something that defies logic. He said it is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness. I want you to hold that phrase, they are new every morning. Do you understand what Jeremiah was saying? He was standing in the middle of complete devastation, the temple was burned, the walls were broken, the people were in captivity. Everything that could go wrong had gone wrong. And yet in the middle of all of that ruin, the prophet made a declaration. He said, "Every morning God loads the day with fresh mercy, not recycled mercy, not left over mercy from yesterday. Fresh, new, original, untouched. The supply has never been used before. Every single morning there is a delivery from heaven that arrives before the sun rises. And that delivery contains everything you will need for the next 24 hours. Now hold that thought because I'm going somewhere. Turn with me to Psalm 118 verse 24. David said, "This is the day which the Lord hath made. We will rejoice and be glad in it." Now most people quote that scripture as a greeting, "Good morning. This is the day the Lord has made." They put it on coffee mugs and t-shirts, but David was not making a casual statement. He was making a declaration of ownership. He was saying, "This day with all its unknowns, with all its challenges, with all its potential dangers and hidden enemies, this day belongs to God. He made it, he authored it, he engineered it, and because he's the maker of this day, I have the legal right to rejoice because the manufacturer determines the purpose and the outcome." Listen carefully. There are dimensions to these that most believers never explore. When you wake up in the morning, you are not just waking up into another 24 hours of random events. You are stepping into a day that was designed before time began. Psalm 139:16, David said, "Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect, and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them." Every day of your life was written in a book before you were born. There is a script, there is a blueprint, there is a divine design for today. And the question is not whether God has a plan for this day. The question is whether you will align with that plan or walk through the day blind, deaf, and disconnected from the counsel of heaven. And this is why morning prayer is not optional. Morning prayer is not for super spiritual people. Morning prayer is the mechanism by which you download the blueprint for the day. It is the moment you sit with the architect before you walk onto the construction site. No wise builder starts building without consulting the blueprint. No wise soldier enters the battlefield without receiving intelligence, and no wise believer should step into a new day without first commanding it in prayer. Now, that word command, I need you to sit with it because this is what the spirit of God dropped in my spirit for this morning. Isaiah 45:11, God says something absolutely staggering. He says, "Thus saith the Lord, the holy one of Israel and his maker, ask me of things to come concerning my sons and concerning the work of my hands, command ye me." God, the sovereign Lord, the creator of the ends of the earth looked at his children and said, "Command ye me." Not beg me, not grovel before me, command. Now, that is not arrogance, that is authority. There is a difference between a beggar making a request and a son making a decree. A beggar says, "Please, if you will, if it is not too much trouble." A son says, "Father, this is what is needed, release it." Because the son knows his identity. He knows his rights, he knows the covenant. And the morning The morning is the courtroom of heaven. It is the time when you take your seat as a royal priest. Revelation 1:6, He has made us kings and priests unto God. And as a king, you have the authority to legislate. As a priest, you have the authority to intercede. The morning is where these two offices converge. You stand as king and priest and you command the day. Not with arrogance, not with presumption, but with covenant authority, with the blood of Jesus as your legal backing, with the word of God as your constitution. With the name of Jesus as your seal of authority. And let me tell you what happens when a believer commands their day. Genesis 1, go back to the beginning. In the beginning, the earth was without form and void, and darkness was upon the face of the deep. The earth was chaotic, disordered, dark, purposeless. Sound familiar? That is what many many days look like. Chaos, confusion, things going wrong from the moment they open their eyes. Flat tires, arguments, bad news, delays, disappointments. The days without form and void. But what did God do? Genesis 1:3, and God said, "Let there be light." And there was light. God spoke. He opened his mouth and commanded the chaos. He did not negotiate with the darkness. He did not have a conference with the void. He did not set up a committee to discuss the situation. He spoke one word and everything changed. And here is the revelation. You were made in the image of that God. Genesis 1:26, you are made in the image and likeness of the one who commands with his words. You carry the DNA of the one who spoke light into darkness. Which means your mouth, anointed by the Holy Ghost, backed by the blood of Jesus, aligned with the word of God, your mouth has the power to command your day. Proverbs 18:21, death and life are in the power of the tongue. Not just life, death and life. Your tongue can create or destroy. Your tongue can open doors or shut them. Your tongue can release blessings or invite curses. And many of you, I say this with love, many of you have been cursing your own days with your own mouths. You wake up and the first thing you say is, "Uh-huh. I do not feel like today. Today is going to be terrible. I just know something bad is going to happen. Nothing good ever happens to me." And then you wonder why the day unfolds exactly as you spoke it. Job 22:28, "Thou shall also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." You have the power to decree. You have the ability to establish. But you must open your mouth. You must use your authority. You must command the day before the day commands you. And that is what we're about to do tonight. We're not just going to pray polite prayers. We are going to command. We are going to decree. We are going to legislate from the courts of heaven. We're going to speak to every element of this new day and tell it to bow to the lordship of Jesus Christ. Thus saith the spirit of God, the reason some of you have been experiencing defeat is not because the enemy is strong. It is because you have been silent. You have been waking up without a word. Stepping into your day without a decree, entering the arena without your weapon, and your weapon is your mouth armed with the word of God. Hebrews 4:12, the word of God is quick and powerful and sharper than any two-edged sword. You have a sword, but a sword in the sheath is useless. You must draw it. You must swing it. You must use it. Hallelujah. Now, I am going to shift. We're going to pray, but this is not going to be gentle. This is not going to be soft. This is warfare. This is fire. And if you can, stand to your feet. If you cannot stand, raise your hand, but engage your spirit. Lock in. Focus. Because the next 30 minutes are going to determine the quality of your entire day. The next 30 minutes are an investment into everything that will unfold from the moment you step out of your door until the moment you return. Are you ready? Say, "I am ready." Father, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I come before your throne of grace this morning not as a beggar, not as a stranger, but as a blood-bought, spirit-filled, covenant-carrying child the most high God. I come with boldness because the blood of Jesus has given me access. Hebrews 4:16, I come boldly onto the throne of grace that I may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need. And I present this day before you every hour, every minute, every second, every interaction, every conversation, every decision, every journey, every transaction. I laid all on the altar of prayer and I say Father, take control. Your will be done on this day as it is in heaven. Matthew 6:10. Not my will, not the enemy's will, not the will of any witch or wizard or agent of darkness. Your will, only your will. Now, pray with me. Open your mouth and pray. I command this day to align with the purposes of God for my life. I speak to the morning and I say morning, hear the word of the Lord. You will not bring sorrow, you will bring joy. You will not bring loss, you will bring gain. You will not bring death, you will bring life. I command every hour of this day to release favor, release breakthrough, release open doors, release supernatural connections, release resources, release miracles. I speak to the afternoon and I say no evil shall hide in the afternoon hours. No trap shall spring, no ambush shall succeed, no accident shall occur. The angel of the Lord encamps around me. Psalm 34:7. From 12:00 noon to 6:00 in the evening, I am covered. I am protected. I am guarded. I am shielded. I speak to the evening and I say I will return home safely. I will return with testimony. I will return with my health intact, my mind sound, my body whole, my spirit strong. No harm will visit my dwelling place. Psalm 91:10. No evil shall befall me, neither shall any plague come nigh my dwelling. I speak to the night and I say my sleep will be sweet. Proverbs 3:24. When I lie down, I shall not be afraid. My sleep shall be sweet. No nightmare, no attack in the dream. No spiritual manipulation while I am sleeping, no astral projection, no marine visitation, no incubus, no succubus, nothing. The blood of Jesus covers my sleep. The fire of God surrounds my bed. I am hidden in the secret place of the most high. Psalm 91:1. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Pray. Pray. Pray. Hallelujah. Now, listen. I am going to pray over specific areas. Agree with me in the spirit. When I decree, say amen. When I declare, receive it into your spirit. I am praying over your movement today. Some of you will drive. Some of you will fly. Some of you will take public transport. Some of you will walk. Whatever means of transportation you use today, I cover it with the blood of Jesus. I nullify every accident programmed against your journey. I cancel every demonic appointment arranged along your route. I scatter every roadblock. I remove every checkpoint of darkness. Isaiah 52:12. For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight. For the Lord will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your rear ward. The Lord goes before you. He's your vanguard. He clears the road and he's behind you. He's your rear guard. He watches your back. Nothing can ambush you from the front because he's there. Nothing can attack you from behind because he is there. You are surrounded. You are enclosed. You are covered on every side. Every road you will travel today, I consecrate it with the blood of Jesus. Every vehicle you will enter, I sanctify it by fire. Every elevator, every staircase, every building, every office, the presence of God goes with you. Exodus 33:14, "My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest." I decree no accident, no crash, no collision, no robbery on the road, no kidnapping, no carjacking, none of it. The blood of Jesus is a wall of fire around your movement. Pray. Pray in the spirit. Now, I am moving to your workplace. Somebody is about to walk into a place where there are enemies disguised as colleagues, where there is witchcraft disguised as office politics, where there are altars of sabotage built in conference rooms and behind computer screens. But, I decree that the fire of God goes before you into that office. Before you arrive, the atmosphere has already been purged. The spirits of jealousy, manipulation, backstabbing, and sabotage, they are bound. They are gagged. They cannot operate against you today. Psalm 23:5, "Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies." God is not going to remove your enemies from the office. He's going to prepare a table of promotion, of favor, of success, of recognition right in front of their faces. They will watch you prosper. They will watch you excel. They will watch doors open for you that they have been trying to open for years, and they will know that there is a God who fights for his people. I decree that your work is blessed today. Everything your hands touch will prosper. Deuteronomy 28:8, "The Lord shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses and in all that thou settest thine hand unto." I speak to your proposals, they will be accepted. I speak to your presentations, they will be received with favor. I speak to your negotiations, the outcome will be in your favor. I speak to your sales, they will multiply. I speak to your projects, they will succeed. I speak to your deadlines, you will meet them with time to spare. Not by your power, not by your might, but by the spirit of the Lord. Zechariah 4:6. Somebody is going to walk into their workplace today and receive news that they did not expect. A promotion, an offer, a raise, a transfer to a better position, an invitation to a new opportunity. I see it in the spirit. The door is opening right now. Before you even arrive, the door is already open. Walk in. Walk in. Walk in with confidence. Hallelujah. Now I'm speaking to finances because somebody connected to this prayer, your financial gates have been locked. You have been working, but you have not been prospering. You have been earning, but the money disappears before you can account for it. Haggai 1:6. Ye have sown much and bring in little. Ye eat, but ye have not enough. Ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink. Ye clothe you, but there is none warm. And he that earneth wages, earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes. That is a spiritual condition. That is not just bad budgeting. That is a devourer at work. Malachi 3:11. I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground. And I'm standing in the office of the prophet this morning, and I'm rebuking the devourer. I am rebuking the spirit that eats money, the spirit that creates emergencies every time you are about to save. The spirit that breaks things every time you are about to rest financially. The spirit that sends unexpected bills and expenses at strategic moments. I rebuke it, I bind it, I paralyze it. And I cast it out of your financial territory in the name of Jesus. I open every financial gate that has been shut. I speak to the north, the south, the east, and the west. Release what belongs to this child of God. Release the contracts, release the clients, release the inheritance, release the favor with banks and financial institutions. Release the unexpected income. Release the supernatural provision. Philippians 4:19, "My God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." Not according to the economy, not according to the inflation rate, not according to the exchange rate, according to his riches in glory. The supply is from a realm that no recession can affect. The supply is from a dimension that no government policy can diminish. I decree that this day carries financial breakthrough. Before this day ends, somebody will receive money that they did not work for. Somebody will receive a gift. Somebody will receive a business idea that will generate millions. Somebody will receive a phone call that changes their financial status permanently. I see it. I see it in the spirit. The Lord is about to do something unusual. Raba shondo ke yira mo. Shanda le reko basimo sendi riba. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Someone under the sound of my voice right now, the Lord is saying the business you wrote off resurrect it. Go back to that idea. Go back to that plan. I killed the first version because you were not ready, but now you are ready. And the second version will prosper beyond anything the first could have achieved. I do not know who that is for, but if that witness bears in your spirit, if something leaped when you heard those words, receive it. Do not let it pass. Write it down. That is a prophetic instruction. Obey it. Now, I am praying over health and body. I speak to everybody connected to this prayer. I speak to blood. I speak to organs. I speak to bones. I speak to tissue. I speak to cells. I speak to DNA. Hear the word of the Lord this morning. Exodus 15:26, "I am the Lord that healeth thee." He did not say, "I am the Lord who sometimes heals." He said, "I am the Lord that healeth thee." Healing is not something he does occasionally. It is who he is. It is his nature. It is his identity. And because he is in you, Christ in you, the hope of glory. Colossians 1:27, his healing nature is in your body right now. So, I speak to sickness, you are trespassing. You are an illegal occupant. This body is the temple of the Holy Ghost. 1 Corinthians 6:19, and no disease has a right to dwell where God dwells. I command blood pressure to normalize. I command sugar levels to stabilize. I command every cancerous cell to die at the root. I command fibroids to dissolve. I command tumors to shrink and disappear. I command blocked arteries to open. I command failing kidneys to be restored. I command weak hearts to be strengthened. I command every autoimmune condition to bow. Lupus, bow. Rheumatoid arthritis, bow. Sickle cell, bow. You bow to the name that is above every name. Philippians 2:9-10, at the name of Jesus, every knee shall bow. Somebody listening, the Lord is showing me there has been a recurring pain in your lower back for months, maybe years. Doctors have not been able to explain it fully. Some days it is bearable. Other days it paralyzes you. The Lord says this is not medical. This is spiritual. And today I am severing the root. I command that spirit of infirmity to release its hold right now. Luke 13:12, Jesus saw the woman who had been bent over for 18 years and said, "Woman, thou art loose from thine infirmity. You are loosed right now in the name of Jesus." Move your back. Stretch. Something has left. Something is leaving right now. Receive your healing. And there is someone else. Headaches. Constant persistent headaches that cloud your thinking and drain your energy. The Lord says it is connected to a spiritual attack on your mind. The enemy has been trying to shut down your clarity because there is a decision you need to make. And if you make it with a clear mind, it will propel you into your next season. So he has been attacking your head. But I rebuke that spirit of heaviness. Isaiah 61:3, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness. I release clarity over your mind. I release sharpness over your thinking. The fog lifts now. The cloud breaks now. Think clearly. See clearly. Decide with confidence in the name of Jesus. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Now I am entering a very important realm. I am going to pray over covenants and causes and evil altars. And I need you to be fully engaged for this. Because some of the battles people face are not the result of anything they did. They are the result of agreements made by ancestors, dedications performed in ignorance, rituals conducted in darkness, blood shed on altars that are still speaking. Hebrews 12:24 says that the blood of Jesus speaks better things than the blood of Abel. That means there are bloods that speak. There are sacrifices that have a voice. And some of those voices, the blood of goats, the blood of chickens, the blood shed in village rituals and midnight ceremonies, those voices have been speaking against certain family lines for generations. They have been demanding payment, they have been enforcing patterns, death at a certain age, madness in certain generations, poverty that refuses to break, marriages that always collapse, children that always rebel, sickness that always returns. But tonight, tonight, the blood of Jesus speaks. And it speaks better things, it speaks louder, it carries more authority, it holds more power. And what it says overrides what every other blood has said. So, I speak to every ancestral covenant. I speak to every dedication made on any altar of darkness, whether in the village, whether in the city, whether in the forest, whether by the river, whether at the crossroads, I renounce it. By the blood of Jesus, I renounce every covenant with water spirits. I renounce every covenant with ancestral spirits. I renounce every covenant with the spirit of death. I renounce every covenant with the spirit of poverty. I renounce every covenant with the spirit of barrenness. I renounce every covenant with any deity, Oshun, Ogun, Amadioha, Sango, any marine queen, any territorial spirit, any principality, any power. The blood of Jesus has annulled every agreement. Colossians 2:14, he has blotted out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross. It is nailed, it is canceled, it is destroyed, it has no legal power, it has no binding force. I am free, my family is free, my children are free, my children's children are free. The chain is broken. The cycle is over. The pattern ends today. Pray this with authority. Do not whisper it, declare it. Every evil altar that has been receiving sacrifice on behalf of my family, I set you on fire. Every priest who serves at that altar, I bind you. Your incantations are powerless. Your rituals are ineffective. Your enchantments are broken. Numbers 23:23, there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel. No enchantment. No divination, no sorcery, no spell, no hex, no charm, nothing. None of it. It will not work. It cannot work because the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob fights for me. I speak to every cause of untimely death, you are broken. I speak to every cause of near success syndrome, where you always almost make it but never quite get there, broken. I speak to every cause of marital failure, broken. I speak to every cause that says you will never amount to anything, broken. I speak to every word spoken over you by a bitter relative, an angry parent, a jealous neighbor, a wicked in-law, those words are null, those words are void, those words carry no power. I reverse them, I cancel them, I override them with the word of God. And the word of God says in Jeremiah 29:11, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil to give you an expected end." Your end is good, your end is peace, your end is glory. No cause can change what God has decreed. Shakandri Moherila Beko, Rabashiki Nomola Kosendri Baleme. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. I am not done. There is more. The spirit of God is pressing me. There is more. I speak now to the realm of destiny, your divine purpose, the reason you were born, the assignment that was written in heaven before you took your first breath. Somebody's destiny has been under siege. The enemy has been attacking your purpose. He has been trying to confuse you, trying to distract you, trying to make you forget why you are here. Trying to get you so caught up in survival that you'll never step into significance. But Jeremiah 1:5, "Before I formed thee in the belly, I knew thee. And before thou camest forth out of the womb, I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations." Before Before you were born before your parents even conceived the idea of you, God had already known you, sanctified you, and ordained you. Your destiny is not fragile. It is not accidental. It is not a maybe. It is a divine ordination. So, I decree every hand of darkness that has been sitting on someone's destiny, I command it to be removed by fire. Every spiritual padlock placed on someone's calling, I command it to break. Every assignment of confusion, every spirit of destruction, every demonic rerouting of purpose, I nullify it, I cancel it, I overrule it in the courts of heaven. I speak to your gifts, your talents, your abilities, that thing you were born to do, that thing that makes you come alive, I command it to resurrect. I command it to awaken. I command it to blossom. The world is waiting for what you carry. The generation needs what God put in your belly. Romans 8:19, "For the earnest expectation of the creature waited for the manifestation of the sons of God. Creation is waiting for you. Do not die with your assignment unfulfilled. Do not leave this earth without delivering your message, singing your song, building your building, writing your book, launching your business, planting your church, raising your family. I decree today your destiny is activated. Not next year, not in 5 years, today. The next chapter begins today. The next level starts today. What has been dormant is waking up. What has been suppressed is being released. What has been buried is coming to the surface. Receive it. Receive it by faith. Now I'm speaking to marriage because the spirit of God is highlighting this. There are people connected to this prayer who have been believing God for a life partner and the wait has been long. The wait has been painful. Friends have married, younger ones have married, and you are still waiting. And the enemy has been whispering God has forgotten you. You are not lovable. Something is wrong with you. I rebuke that lie from the pit of hell. God has not forgotten you. Genesis 2:18, "And the Lord God said, 'It is not good that the man should be alone. I will make him an helpmate for him.'" God himself said it is not good for you to be alone. If God said it is not good, he will not leave you in that state. He is working. He's arranging. He's orchestrating connections that your mind cannot fathom. I decree that every satanic delay on someone's marital destiny is terminated right now. Every spirit husband, every spirit wife, every marine covenant that has been blocking your union in the physical, I command it to break. I command divorce in the spirit realm between you and any demonic entity that has claimed you. You are not married in the spirit. You are not betrothed to any demon. You belong to Christ. And Christ is presenting you to your earthly spouse. The connection is being made, the meeting is being arranged. Before this season ends, somebody under the sound of my voice will testify. And for those who are already married, but the marriage is under attack, I speak peace. I speak restoration. I speak tenderness where there has been hardness. I speak forgiveness where there has been bitterness. I speak communication where there has been silence. Malachi 2:16, God hates divorce. And what God hates, he fights against. So, the spirit of division that has entered your home, I cast it out. The spirit of infidelity that has been whispering, I silence it. The spirit of constant conflict, I bind it. Peace be upon your home. Peace be upon your marriage. Peace be upon your children. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Now, I speak to family deliverance. Every household connected to this prayer, I release the fire of God into your bloodline. I break every generational pattern that has been operating in your family. Whatever happened to your mother will not happen to you. Whatever destroyed your father will not destroy you. Whatever limited your grandparents will not limit you. Ezekiel 18:20, "The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father." You are not responsible for the sins of your ancestors, and you will not suffer for what they did. The blood of Jesus has drawn a line, and on this side of that line, there is freedom. There is blessing. There is life. Every family curse broken. Every household idol dethroned. Every monitoring spirit assigned to your family, I blind its eyes, I confuse its intelligence, I scatter its operations. My family belongs to God. My household is under the covering of the blood of Jesus. As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. Joshua 24:15. Someone, the name is coming to me. There is someone whose mother has been sick. Not just physically sick, there is a spiritual root, something connected to the family line. A covenant that was made when she was young. The Lord says, "I am breaking it, not tomorrow, today. The root is being severed. Watch her recovery begin within the next 7 days. Receive it. Receive it with Thanksgiving." I speak to someone whose family has been fragmented, siblings scattered, parents estranged, relationships broken. The Lord says, "I am a God of restoration. What the enemy scattered, I am gathering." Ezekiel 37, these dry bones shall live. There is going to be a reunion. There is going to be reconciliation. There is going to be a coming together that only God could orchestrate. Not by human effort, by divine intervention, the God who parted the Red Sea can certainly mend a broken family. Shabakore milandi sondribay, recolayamashan dribakonamila. Hallelujah. I am pressing further. I sense the spirit of God intensely right now. There is something happening in the realm of the spirit. Angels are being dispatched. Chains are being broken. Doors are being opened. I can feel it. Can you feel it? I am praying now for witchcraft destruction. Every witchcraft operation targeted against anyone under the sound of my voice, I decree confusion into the camp of the enemy. Every coven that has sat down to discuss your case, I scatter that meeting by the thunder of God. Psalm 18:14. Yea, he sent out his arrows and scattered them, and he shot out lightnings and discomfited them. Every monitoring spirit that has been tracking your movements, I blind your eyes, I deafen your ears, I sever your connection to any agent of darkness in my environment. You will no longer report on me. You will no longer give intelligence about my activities. I am hidden in Christ. Colossians 3:3, "For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God." I am hidden. Invisible to the kingdom of darkness. They cannot see me, they cannot find me, they cannot track me. I am off the radar of the enemy. Every evil projection, every astral attack, every night flying, every spiritual arrow, I send it back to sender. Not with malice, but with justice. Let the fire of God intercept every projection. Let the blood of Jesus neutralize every poison. Let the angels of the Lord pursue every attacking spirit and give them no rest until they flee. Psalm 35:5-6, "Let them be as chaff before the wind, and let the angel of the Lord chase them. Let their way be dark and slippery, and let the angel of the Lord persecute them." Every evil pot that has been cooking something against my life, I overturn it. Every cauldron where my picture has been placed, I shatter it. Every mirror used for remote viewing of my activities, I break it. Every grave where any part of my virtue has been buried, earth, open up and release what belongs to me. I am speaking with authority. This is not hope. This is not wish. This is decree. This is command.
